# Damas Hotel Fujairah

> Damas Hotel is an eight-storey hotel complex in Fujairah, arranged over a basement, ground floor and seven upper levels. It provides guest rooms and hotel facilities in an emirate on the United Arab Emirates' east coast known for its beaches, mountain scenery and diving sites on the Gulf of Oman. Hotels of this size serve both leisure visitors and business travellers using Fujairah's port and free zone.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Fujairah, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This hotel complex in Fujairah was developed by Damas Real Estate and rises over a basement, ground floor and seven upper levels. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the hotel for Damas Real Estate, with Adnan Saffarini as consultant. The project reflects MENASCO's experience in delivering building services for hospitality developments on the UAE's east coast.
